name: wtf-meter
description: Counts the swearing in your prompts (English, German, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian) and shows how heated the session is getting

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: meter: how heated this session is (cools down). jar: a swear jar that only fills, 25 cents per point.

name.title: Name in Slack posts
name.description: Jar mode: how teammates see you in the Slack channel.

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack incoming webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.description: Jar mode posts to this channel webhook. Leave empty to keep the jar local.
